expiry_proposal.rationale: A 30-day maximum review cycle for unchanged source-owned adapters. Exact SOURCE, lock, package descriptors and file hashes invalidate this review when changed. Full registry/native dependency audits remain fresh and independently blocking; current-date publication admission and expiry remain enforced. New relevant advisories or source findings require immediate reassessment rather than waiting for expiry.

fresh_ancestor_queries.scope: Two direct official OSV package-version queries for the derivative ancestors; not the full registry or native dependency audit.

Current advisory and native/registry admission remain independently mandatory.
No automatic renewal and no broad safety claim.

limitations: This is not vulnerability-free, native AWS-LC, registry-dependency, compiled-binary, ABI, side-channel or complete memory-safety clearance.
Historical fixture tests and prior reviews were reused, not rerun.
Inherited whole RPC body and JSON allocations precede bounded DTO decoding.
Bandwidth cancellation after a submitted INSERT but before notification remains unqualified.
AWS-LC may abort on insufficient entropy; packaged recovery of that condition remains unqualified.
Secret cleanup covers inspected owned storage, not caller copies or all stack/register/allocator remnants.
Legacy key-width/exponent policy and explicit absent-broker-keys no-root mode remain unchanged.
Fresh ancestor and current full dependency security admission remain separate mandatory checks; this review makes no advisory-absence claim.
observations: RAII owners release native Bn/Ctx/Mont/Rsa values on inspected error paths; borrowed n/e remain under the owning key.
No native handle crosses await; OwnedPending contains owned bytes and is consumed on finalization with response mathematical-key binding.
Mizaru bounds DER, signature representative and Merkle branch decoding and direct DTO use; expected epoch and configured root are checked before credential publication.
Auth generates a random token before untrusted subkey retrieval and preserves the request-selected Plus/Free root; malformed configured root cannot silently become no-root mode.
Bandwidth INSERT follows successful unblind with the configured original issuer key; consumer listen-before-recheck avoids the ordinary notification race.
The previously fixed is_plus != currently_plus cache invalidation remains byte-identical.

limitations.boundary: No current registry or native dependency security admission. Independent fresh CI audit must assess the combined source, lock, enabled features and native AWS-LC/SQLite inventory; old RSA exceptions must not be extended or used.

No new side-channel, sanitizer, fuzz, custom-allocator or cross-architecture validation was run. Pinned native API contracts and bounded FFI inspection are not blanket cryptographic or memory-safety assurance.
Pinned AWS-LC RNG may abort when sufficient entropy is unavailable. Packaged process containment/recovery is unqualified; returned errors are not evidence of recoverable entropy failure.
SecretBytes/BN cleanup covers inspected owned live storage, not every caller-owned token copy, stack/register copy, allocator configuration or complete erasure.
Inherited whole RPC body/JSON allocation occurs before bounded Mizaru DTO decoding. No transport body-size or JSON-depth hardening claim is made.

Retained cancellation checks do not establish rollback or notification recovery for a bandwidth INSERT already submitted before cancellation ahead of BW_TOKEN_SUPPLIED.notify; an actual operational failure was not reproduced.

Legacy byte-width acceptance permits 2041..4096-bit modulus widths and exponents 3/65537. This is not a new strict 2048-bit minimum or complete issuer-modulus validation. Known legacy 2049-bit blind-encoding bug is intentionally not reproduced.
Absent broker_keys retains explicit inherited unauthenticated-root mode; configured invalid roots fail rather than falling back. The review does not broaden or remove that policy.

Neither retained candidate SOURCE nor C6 SOURCE has a native_sqlite field. Preserve and freshly validate the independent current SQLite native provenance/inventory; do not infer a descriptor from these files.
Available upstream attribution/license declarations were retained; this source review does not provide legal clearance or assert an upstream package-specific notice was recovered.

manual_conclusion: No new confirmed source defect found in the bounded reviewed scope; independent review reaches the same limited conclusion.

observations: The token is generated before fetching an untrusted issuer key. Auth verifies the request-selected level/root and exact epoch before unblind and only then writes conn_token. Invalid configured root decoding returns an error.
Auth retains the is_plus != currently_plus cache invalidation comparison; unchanged historical causal tests are referenced, not rerun.
Bandwidth tokens use the configured key; OwnedPending binds the original mathematical n/e, and INSERT follows verified unblind. The INSERT-versus-notification cancellation limitation remains.
